⚠️ `Servex/Servex.js` now imports `BrowserCheck.mjs`, so the live Servex needs a `sustain.mjs --restart` before it picks that up. That restart is yours as mastermind.

The first undo left one wrong line in `scripts.md`; I changed the manifest to store the original files, and the second run restored everything exactly. It is ready for batches 2–5.
- **Classes:** The three function bags (`CardCheck`, `AntigravityUsage`, `BrowserCheck`) are now classes with static methods. The old named exports stay as one-line aliases until 2026-10-20, which is recorded as a `decision` line in `task.jsonl`.
